chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Abān, from Zurārah, who said:
I heard Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام say: “When a man kills in a sacred month, he fasts two consecutive months from the sacred months.”

key_terms.أَشْهُرِ الْحُرُمِ: the sacred months within which the expiatory fasting is to be observed
key_terms.شَهْرٍ حَرَامٍ: a sacred month in which certain violations carry greater sanctity and seriousness
key_terms.صَامَ: he must fast as an act of expiation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for the expiatory fast when killing occurs in a sacred month?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning expiation for killing committed during a sacred month. It states that the required fasting of two consecutive months is to be observed within the sacred months, highlighting the added sanctity and gravity of the offense in that time.
